2026-09-23 DETAIL — Rollouts and Security Review
Two bots for the final stages of code deployment. Teams and Enterprise plans only.

ROLLOUTS
- "attaches a monitor to every pull request and watches the change as it deploys, reporting
  change health per environment: verified healthy, regression detected, or inconclusive."
- On PR open: reads the diff and the systems it touches, writes a monitoring plan as a PR
  comment listing identified risks, intended effects, signals to check, instrumentation gaps.
- Wakes on deploy events for the change's commit; runs the plan against logs, metrics, traces.
- Tracks each environment separately (can be verified in staging, flagged in production).
- On regression: names the suspected change, notifies the author, and depending on config
  CAN OPEN A REVERT PR for review or hand the finding to a cloud agent for a fix.
- Integrations: Origin/GitHub, continuous delivery systems, telemetry providers
  (Datadog, Grafana, Honeycomb).
- Config: enable from the dashboard; connect source control, deploy system, telemetry provider.
- NO /docs/rollouts page exists (HTTP 404 as of 2026-09-24).

SECURITY REVIEW
- Security Reviewer: "reads every pull request in the context of the codebase and posts one
  review comment reporting exploitable bugs."
- Detection scope: SQL/command/template injection, authentication/authorization bypasses,
  secrets/credentials, SSRF, unsafe deserialization, vulnerable dependencies.
- Vulnerability Scanner (companion): scans the codebase AT REST for pre-existing
  vulnerabilities, long-standing issues, and problems missed during PR review.
- Customization: teams add rules for their codebase (e.g. required external call routes,
  query restrictions).
- Config: enable from dashboard per repository; draft PRs excluded.
- Trial credits: ~50 changes (Teams) / ~500 changes (Enterprise) for ten days.
- Docs: https://cursor.com/docs/security-agents , https://cursor.com/docs/security-review
